_doc: Which canonical jobs (game/data/canonical/jobs.json) are playable in this build and what advancing grants (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md section 9). A job missing here is not playable with default_reason. Optional level overrides the canonical advancement level for survivor mode; an option above the player's level shows level_reason instead. grants: max_mp (added to computed base Max MP; grants the increase to current MP unless Improved MaxMP Increase preserves its ratio), skills (learned at once on advancing: the Magician's first SP goes to Energy Bolt), guarantee (the next card draw contains one card of that kind whose requires.jobs lists that job).

200._provenance: tier C: owner choice, first-job advancement at Lv 10; canonical Magician remains Lv 8
